blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Int'l MSME Day 2026: Collateral-Free MSE Loan Limit Doubled from ₹10 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI Governor notes MSMEs contribute 31% of India's GDP and half of merchandise exports.
Collateral Cap Doubled: Mandatory collateral-free loan limit for MSEs doubled from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh (extendable to ₹25 lakh).
Account Aggregator Impact: AA framework facilitated ₹3.5 lakh crore lending in FY26.
Pre-Payment Charge Ban: Commercial banks barred from levying pre-payment penalties on floating-rate MSE loans.
Standard MSE collateral-free limit (₹20 lakh) vs good track record limit (₹25 lakh).
